caseName: GHe pressurant bottle, 100 N hydrazine monopropellant system
linkedCaseNote: The three inherited values below are produced by fluidSystems/codeInterface.py. They are stated here rather than recomputed so the coupling between the two directories is visible in the configuration rather than buried in code.

allowablesSample.note: A synthetic 30 specimen Ti-6Al-4V ultimate strength sample with a 3.2 percent coefficient of variation, drawn from a fixed seed so the worked example is reproducible. Real programme data would replace this.

bracket.note: The 6061-T6 mounting bracket the bottle boss lands on, which is the galvanic couple that matters.

manifold.note: The secondary leg: an LPBF Inconel 718 thruster valve manifold, which closes the loop back into the fluid system pressure drop.
